title: Fix default bin assignment when creating purchase orders for drop shipments
summary: Fixed default bin assignment for drop shipments when creating purchase orders from sales orders. The requisition line no longer incorrectly receives a default bin during item validation when the drop-shipment flag is set.
key_points: Set the drop-shipment flag on requisition lines before validating item and variant details
Prevent default-bin assignment for drop shipments during validation
Preserve default-bin selection for regular orders and bin consistency checks
Added four regression tests covering drop-shipment and ordinary orders with and without item variants
quote: Bin Code must be equal to '' in Requisition Line. Current value is 'B003'.
